newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares mixed, foreign tone to set trend.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares mixed, foreign tone to set trend.

text.p: Portuguese shares ended mixed, with futures on the PSI20 index of 20 leading stocks firmer, and turnover in the cash market stood at 13.1 billion escudos. Dealers said the foreign tone would set the trend tomorrow, with investors' attention focused on economic data from the U.S.. Investors took profits in Sonae Industria and Inparsa, which fell by 3.69 and 4.05 percent respectively after surging last week, dealers said. Good prospects for the six-month results of Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor and insurer Imperio boosted their share prices. BPSM shares surged by 4.03 percent amid market expectations that it will report a six-month profit of around 8.5 billion escudos, and Imperio rose by 7.24 percent. Construction firms Mota and Somague hit highs amid optimism over the company's expected profits this year.
* "I think the market will improve in terms of prices and turnover tomorrow, but there will be some concern over the impact of the U.S. economic data on the markets," a dealer said.
